memory.content: JobNimbus has no official connector in the plugin marketplace; Composio's jobnimbus toolkit (API-key auth entered on Composio's connect page) is the simplest route in, with the raw JobNimbus API key as fallback.

JobNimbus API keys are created under Settings > API > + Create New, inherit their Access Profile's permissions, are shown only once, and expire one year after creation (https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-api-key).

---
name: jobnimbus-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation with a new owner of a JobNimbus guide bot: learn
  their trade, admin access, goals and what must wait for their yes, then get
  JobNimbus connected and verified.
---
# JobNimbus getting started

I work inside JobNimbus as you, with the access you grant. Ask one question at a time, skip any you can infer, and drop the questions the moment they hand you real work.

1. Ask what trade they're in: roofing, siding, solar, restoration, or general contracting.
2. Ask whether they're a JobNimbus account admin. If not, plan for an admin to create the API key.
3. Ask what they want handled: lead follow-up, the job board, tasks, estimates and invoices, insurance-claim jobs, or reports.
4. Ask what should always wait for their yes, offering this default: deletes, bulk changes over 10 records, messages to homeowners, adjusters or crews, changes to estimates, invoices or payments, and billing or user changes. Save their answer to memory as the permission list. Also ask whether JobNimbus access needs a VPN, an office network, or an IP allowlist.
5. Save a short account map to memory (trade, admin or not, goals). Never save credentials.
6. Connect, simplest route first (see jobnimbus-knowledge-base): an official JobNimbus connector if one exists, otherwise Composio's JobNimbus toolkit (start the connection and share the connect link), otherwise the JobNimbus API key through a masked secret request. Give one step at a time with menu names from the current JobNimbus help docs, and cite them. Say plainly that the key gets whatever its Access Profile allows, recommend a separate key just for this bot, and mention keys expire after a year. Never take a key in chat. If access only works from their network, suggest connecting their own computer and running calls from there.
7. Verify with one read-only test, such as the 5 most recent jobs with their status. Call it connected only once that test passes.
8. Map their workflows, statuses, record types, custom fields, task types and team, save the map, offer 3 starter prompts that fit their trade, then offer the weekday daily brief and the routines in jobnimbus-playbook. Create a routine only when they say yes.
9. From then on, notice repeated manual steps, apps they mention, and data they copy between systems, and recommend one fitting connector, plugin, skill or routine at a time: what it does, why it fits, and what it costs or needs. Install, connect or create it only on their yes, and don't re-offer one they turned down.

name: jobnimbus-knowledge-base
description: >-
  Use when helping a user connect to or work in JobNimbus (contractor/roofing
  CRM): API docs, API key and Access Profile, core objects,
  workflows/statuses/boards, automations, contractor job lifecycle, Composio and

# JobNimbus knowledge base

Last verified: 2026-10-19. JobNimbus is migrating to a new Platform API and changed API keys in Sept 2026. **Re-check the linked doc live before acting.** Items marked *verify in docs* were not confirmed today.

## 1. APIs (two generations)
| API | Base URL | Docs | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform API (new) | `https://api.jobnimbus.com` (`/{service}/v1/{endpoint}`) | [S1] | Bearer API key. Has a deprecation policy: sunsets at quarter end, at least 6 months' notice, `Deprecation`/`Sunset` headers [S2]. Reference lists activities, activity types, conversations, phone numbers, products, companies, and auth/switch-company (*check the reference for current coverage*) [S3] |
| Public API (legacy "api1") | `https://app.jobnimbus.com/api1/` | [S4] | Covers contacts, jobs, tasks, activities, files, products, material orders, work orders, estimates (legacy), invoices, payments, account settings/workflows [S4] |

## 2. API key: creation and access
- Create: profile icon > Settings > **API** > **+ Create New**, add a description, pick an **Access Profile**, Create, Copy [S5]. The developer doc phrases the menu as Settings > API Keys [S1].
- The key is shown **once**. Use the full key (130+ characters), not the short dashed Key ID. A 401 often means the Key ID was pasted [S5].
- Permissions: the key inherits its Access Profile **as it was when the key was created**. Later profile edits don't apply; create a new key [S5][S6].
- Expiry: new keys expire **one year** after creation. Keys created before **Sept 18, 2026** are legacy keys; they also expire and can't be edited or newly created [S5].
- Errors: 401 means no Authorization header; 403 means an invalid, expired, or revoked key, or a valid key without permission for the action [S1].
- Legacy API: an admin-level key can pass `?actor=<user email>` to act with that user's permissions and set "Created By" [S4].
- Least privilege: JobNimbus's dev doc says to use the most restrictive profile that works [S1]. (Its help center suggests Full + Settings access for convenience [S6]. Prefer least privilege and widen only when a task fails on permissions.)
- Store the key only as a masked bot secret.

## 3. Core objects
| Object | What it is | API (legacy unless noted) |
|---|---|---|
| Contact | A person or company [S7] | `api1/contacts` CRUD |
| Job | A piece of work; one contact can have several jobs [S7] | `api1/jobs` CRUD |
| Task | To-do with type, assignees, dates | `api1/tasks` |
| Activity | Notes/log entries on records | `api1/activities` (create/read); Platform API `/v1/activities` [S3] |
| Estimate | Legacy estimates via `api1/v2/estimates` [S4] | New Sales Experience estimates: *verify API coverage in docs* |
| Invoice / Payment | `api1/v2/invoices`, `api1/payments` [S4] | |
| Work order / Material order | `api1/v2/workorders`, `api1/v2/materialorders` [S4] | |
| File (attachment) | Uploads via `files/v1/uploads/...`; older create-file endpoints deprecated [S4] | |
| Workflow / status | Pipeline for Contact, Job, or Work Order records [S8] | `api1/account/workflow` (create workflow/status) [S4] |

**Workflows and stages**: each workflow has statuses; each status maps to one fixed stage: Lead, Estimating, Sold, In Production, Accounts Receivable, Completed. **Lost** can be reached from any stage [S8][S7]. Job Type = the workflow name (e.g. Retail, Insurance, Commercial) [S7].
**Boards** show cards per column; a column's status, not its name, decides what shows. New workflows/statuses don't auto-appear on boards unless built with the Job Workflow & Boards Builder [S8][S9].

### API query notes (legacy) [S4]
- Lists: `size` (default and max 1000), `from` (offset), `sort_field`, `sort_direction`, `fields`, and `filter` (URL-encoded JSON, Elasticsearch-style `must`/`term`/`terms`).
- "Delete" endpoints are a PUT setting `{"is_active": false}`.
- `skip=automation,notification` bypasses automations and notifications on writes. Use it only when the user asks.
- `bulk=true` saves optimistically; search may lag a few seconds.

## 4. Rate limits
Not documented on the pages checked today (developer portal, Postman docs). *Verify in docs.* Back off on 429/5xx, page with `size` <= 1000, and avoid bursts.

## 5. Automations (UI)
- Settings > Automation > +Add Automation. Triggers are **Event-based** (record Created / Modified / Created or Modified / Deleted) or **Time-based** (X time before/after a date such as Date Status Changed) [S10][S11].
- Trigger records: Contact, Job, Task, Work Order, Material Order, Payment, Attachment, Activity [S10].
- Conditions: workflow type, status, custom fields, etc. "Only if Type is modified" (event-based only) prevents re-firing; all/any logic [S12].
- Actions include Create Task, Change Status, and texts via Engage [S10][S11].

## 6. Contractor job lifecycle (map to statuses)
| Phase | Typical stage | Records involved |
|---|---|---|
| Lead captured | Lead | Contact (+ lead source), Task: call |
| Inspection scheduled/done | Lead / Estimating | Job, Task/calendar, photos (Files), Activity notes |
| Estimate sent / signed | Estimating > Sold | Estimate, Activity |
| Insurance claim / supplement (insurance workflow) | Estimating to Sold (claim) or In Production (supplement) | Custom fields (claim #, carrier, adjuster, supplement status), Tasks, Files |
| Production | In Production | Work Orders, Material Orders, Tasks |
| Final invoice / collect | Accounts Receivable | Invoice, Payments |
| Closed | Completed (or Lost) | |
Status names vary by account. Read the user's workflows first and never assume them.

## 7. Connection options
| Route | Status |
|---|---|
| Official connector in this app | Use if offered |
| Official JobNimbus MCP | None found on jobnimbus.com docs today. *Verify in docs* |
| Composio toolkit | https://composio.dev/toolkits/jobnimbus (exists; auth flow *verify on the page*) |
| Community MCP servers (**community, unofficial**) | e.g. github.com/clykins90/jobnimbus-mcp-server (npm `jobnimbus-mcp-server`, uses `JOBNIMBUS_API_KEY`); hosted third-party servers exist. Unvetted: don't recommend without user review |
| API key as masked secret | Fallback; call the API directly |

**Verify step**: list 5 contacts and 5 jobs with their status, plus the workflow list. Connected only when this passes.

## 8. High-risk areas
- Bulk status changes fire automations (texts, tasks) for every record. Test on one record first.
- Deactivating contacts/jobs (`is_active:false`) hides them. Confirm first.
- `skip=automation` silently skips the user's rules.
- Payments, invoices, and QuickBooks sync touch money and accounting. Read-only unless the user explicitly approves.
- Access Profile changes affect what team members see [S13].

## 9. Doc-link directory
- [S1] Authorization (Platform API): https://developer.jobnimbus.com/docs/authorization
- [S2] Deprecation policy: https://developer.jobnimbus.com/docs/deprecation
- [S3] Platform API reference: https://developer.jobnimbus.com/reference
- [S4] Legacy Public API (Postman): https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/3919598/S11PpG4x
- [S5] Create an API key: https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-api-key
- [S6] API key Access Profile: https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-does-it-mean-to-assign-an-api-key-an-access-profile
- [S7] Analytics (records, stages, job type): https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-is-analytics
- [S8] Workflows: https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-is-a-workflow and https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-add-or-edit-a-workflow
- [S9] Boards builder: https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-use-the-job-workflow-and-boards-builder ; board components: https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-are-the-different-components-of-a-board
- [S10] Event-based automation: https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-event-based-automation
- [S11] Time-based recipe: https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-automation-to-change-the-status-of-a-work-order-and-create-a-task
- [S12] Automation conditions: https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-kind-of-conditions-can-i-use-with-an-automation
- [S13] Access Profiles: https://support.jobnimbus.com/can-i-give-my-team-members-different-access-permissions-in-jobnimbus
- Status page: https://status.jobnimbus.com/

# JobNimbus playbook

Last verified: 2026-10-19. Pair with `jobnimbus-knowledge-base` for API key, endpoints, and query notes. **Re-check JobNimbus help articles live before building**; status names are per-account.

## Operating stance
You are the user's extension within the API key's Access Profile. Do approved routine work freely. Always confirm deactivating records, bulk status moves (they fire automations), invoices/payments/QuickBooks, `skip=automation` writes, and anything on the user's gated list. Read before write. Test on a test job.

## 1. Data hierarchy
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  C[Contact: person or company] --> J1[Job]
  C --> J2[Job ...]
  J1 --> WF[Workflow = Job Type] --> ST[Status] --> SG[Stage: Lead / Estimating / Sold / In Production / AR / Completed / Lost]
  J1 --> T[Tasks]
  J1 --> A[Activities / notes]
  J1 --> E[Estimates]
  J1 --> I[Invoices] --> P[Payments]
  J1 --> WO[Work Orders] 
  J1 --> MO[Material Orders]
  J1 --> F[Files / photos]
  C --> CT[Contact workflow + status]
```
- A **Contact** is a person or company; a **Job** is a piece of work, and one contact can have many jobs. Don't mix them in counts [K1].
- Each status maps to one fixed stage; Lost is reachable from any stage [K1][K2].
- **Job Type** is the workflow name (Retail, Insurance, Commercial) [K1]. Use separate workflows only for different processes (insurance vs retail), not per salesperson.
- Put property and claim facts on the **job** (address, claim #, carrier, adjuster, deductible); put person facts on the **contact**.

## 2. Workflow and board setup
- Build job workflows in Settings > Job Workflow & Boards Builder so boards stay in sync; workflows made elsewhere need statuses added to boards manually [K3][K2].
- Status names: action-state ("Inspection Scheduled", "Supplement Submitted"), 1-3 statuses per stage, consistent tense.
- Board column totals (estimate/invoice totals) count only **approved** estimates toward Estimate Total [K4]. Use board totals for AR and Sold columns.
- Custom fields over free-text notes for anything you filter or automate on (claim status, roof type, lead source).
- Keep Access Profiles least-privilege; workflow visibility can restrict records to assigned reps [K2][K5].

## 3. Automation recipe library
Build in Settings > Automation > +Add Automation; event-based (Created/Modified/Deleted) or time-based (X after a date like Date Status Changed) [K6][K7]. Use "Only if Type is modified" to avoid re-firing on every edit [K8]. Test on a contact/job named `TEST - <recipe>` with your own phone, then check the record's activity and tasks.

| # | Recipe | Trigger | Conditions | Actions | Guardrails |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Speed-to-lead | Event: Contact Created | Status = Lead | Create task "Call within 5 min" for sales rep; Engage text ack | Business hours; SMS consent |
| 2 | Inspection reminder | Time: 1 day before task/appointment date (*verify date fields available*) | Task type = Inspection | Text homeowner; task to rep | Only for scheduled inspections |
| 3 | Estimate follow-up | Time: 3 days after Date Status Changed | Status = Estimate Sent | Task follow-up; text | Stop if status changed (condition on status) |
| 4 | Insurance claim / supplement follow-up | Time: X days after Date Status Changed | Workflow = Insurance, Status = Supplement Submitted / Adjuster Review | Task "Check supplement with adjuster"; optional status move | Use a custom "Supplement Status" field; never auto-mark Approved |
| 5 | Sold handoff to production | Event: Job Modified, only if status modified | Status = Sold/Contract Signed | Create production tasks; notify PM; create work order (manual or API) | Fire once ("Only if ... modified") |
| 6 | Work-order driven status | Time: after Date Status Changed on Work Order | WO Type + Status | Change parent job status; create task (JobNimbus recipe) [K7] | Confirm mapping per workflow |
| 7 | Collections nudge | Time: 7/14/30 days after status = Invoiced | Stage = Accounts Receivable | Task to office; reminder text | No texts for disputed jobs (custom field) |
| 8 | Review request | Event: Job Modified to Completed | Stage = Completed | Wait (time-based 2 days) then text review link | Once per contact |
| 9 | Stuck-job alert | Time: 14 days after Date Status Changed | Any non-terminal status | Task to job owner | Exclude Completed/Lost |

## 4. Proactive audit (after mapping)
1. Duplicate contacts (same phone/email/address).
2. Jobs stuck: days in status above the per-status median (cards show "days in status" [K9]).
3. Jobs missing sales rep, address, lead source, or Job Type.
4. Sold jobs with no approved estimate; completed jobs with an open invoice balance.
5. Statuses not on any board; boards with empty columns [K2][K4].
6. Automations overlapping on the same trigger/status (double tasks/texts).
7. API keys near expiry (1-year life) or legacy keys (pre-2026-09-18) [K10].
8. Custom fields unused (0-5 records).

## 5. Known issues and limitations (2025-2026)
| Date | Issue | Type | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-11 | Some mobile users unable to create activities; supplier integration order failures | Official status | https://status.jobnimbus.com/history.rss |
| 2026-05-12 / 05-20 | Instability in the New Sales Experience, including estimate creation and duplication | Official status | same |
| 2026-05-26 | Elevated API errors; search service disruption | Official status | same |
| 2026-07-13 | Elevated errors in the application | Official status | same |
| 2026-07-21 | ABC Supply integration branch/account failed to load | Official status | same |
| 2026-09-01 | Slow loading for Jobs and Contacts | Official status | same |
| 2026-09-16 | Limited-access users couldn't view newly created estimates | Official status | same |
| 2026-09-18 | API keys reworked: new keys expire after 1 year; older keys are "legacy" and will also expire | Official | [K10] |
| 2026-10-01 | Payment processing outage | Official status | https://status.jobnimbus.com/history.rss |
| Ongoing | API rate limits not published; legacy and Platform APIs coexist with a deprecation policy | Official docs (gap) | [K11][K12] |
| 2026 (undated) | Users cite an aging classic UI and having to switch between classic and new versions | Community (r/RoofingSales). Date not confirmed; Reddit blocked the fetch | https://www.reddit.com/r/RoofingSales/comments/1sncw8t/ |
| Undated | Complaints about automation reliability, notifications, and report accuracy | Community (r/Roofing, r/JobNimbusIssues). Unverified | https://www.reddit.com/r/Roofing/comments/1n1yvrp/ |
Check https://status.jobnimbus.com/ live before debugging "broken" automations.

## 6. Routines to offer (never auto-create)
| Name | Cadence | Reports | Quiet when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Morning job board | Weekdays 7am | Jobs that changed status yesterday; today's inspections/production tasks | No changes and no tasks |
| Stuck-job digest | Mon 8am | Jobs over status-age threshold, by rep | None stuck |
| Supplement tracker | Tue & Thu 9am | Insurance jobs in supplement statuses > X days | None waiting |
| AR / collections | Fri 10am | Open invoice balances by age bucket | Zero open AR |
| API key health | Monthly | Days to key expiry; connection test | Healthy and > 30 days left |

## Sources (fetched 2026-10-19)
- [K1] https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-is-analytics
- [K2] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-add-or-edit-a-workflow ; https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-is-a-workflow
- [K3] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-use-the-job-workflow-and-boards-builder
- [K4] https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-are-the-different-components-of-a-board
- [K5] https://support.jobnimbus.com/can-i-give-my-team-members-different-access-permissions-in-jobnimbus
- [K6] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-event-based-automation
- [K7] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-automation-to-change-the-status-of-a-work-order-and-create-a-task
- [K8] https://support.jobnimbus.com/what-kind-of-conditions-can-i-use-with-an-automation
- [K9] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-can-i-move-a-job-into-another-status-using-boards
- [K10] https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-create-an-api-key
- [K11] https://developer.jobnimbus.com/docs/deprecation
- [K12] https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/3919598/S11PpG4x

skills.name: crm-connect-playbook
skills.description: Use when connecting a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho, Pipedrive, Close, Attio, monday, JobNimbus, or any CRM with docs and an API) and working inside it safely.
skills.content:
---
name: crm-connect-playbook
description: >-
  Use when connecting a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho, Pipedrive,
  Close, Attio, monday, JobNimbus, or any CRM with docs and an API) and working
  inside it safely.
---
# Connect and work in any CRM

## Research
- Read the CRM's current official docs live: API, auth, rate limits, key objects, and whether there's an official connector or MCP server. Never rely on memory for a vendor's current API; these change fast.
- Write a short CRM map: objects, key fields, how auth works, what the user's plan allows. Cite doc links.
- If the plan has no API or connector, say so plainly and offer a fallback: CSV export or import, a spreadsheet mirror, or the plan's upgrade path.

## Connect
- Pick the simplest supported way in, in this order: (1) an official connector or plugin, (2) the vendor's official MCP server via OAuth, (3) an integration platform like Composio, (4) a personal API token as a last resort.
- Give one numbered step at a time, using real menu names from the docs. Don't invent menu paths.
- Ask for read-only scopes first. Add write scopes only when the user wants writes.
- Request any token through the app's masked secret request so it's saved as a bot secret. Never ask for a key in chat, never repeat it, and never write it into memory, a skill, or a file.
- Admin-only steps (enabling an MCP server, creating a private app) may need the CRM admin: give the user a short checklist to forward.

## Verify
- Run one read-only test, such as listing 5 recent contacts or deals, and show the result. It's only connected once that test passes.

## Work
- Read before write. For every create, edit, or update, show the exact change (record, field, old value to new value) and wait for a yes. Bulk changes get a count and a sample first.
- Never delete records, touch billing or user seats, or send customer emails or SMS. Customer messages are drafts the user approves and sends.
- Warn before heavy reads; rate limits and API credits vary by plan.
- Create routines (like a weekly pipeline summary or stale-deal check) only when asked, and stay quiet when there's nothing to report.
